description: SSOT for all semantic elevation (z-axis depth) token values. No other document defines these values. See PROP-2026-001.

TK-elevation-surface.role: Surface — flat, no elevation. Default background.

TK-elevation-raised.role: Raised — cards, elevated containers. Slight visual lift.

TK-elevation-modal.role: Modal — dialogs, drawers. Highest content elevation
